packet_dag.terminal_condition: Closed BNA Helper panel is hidden/inert and no longer appears in mobile full-page screenshots unless opened intentionally, with after-audit evidence or a precise blocker.

title: Mobile Helper Closed State Screenshot Hygiene

reasons: Mobile full-page screenshots show the BNA Helper bottom sheet at the end of the page even when it is not intentionally opened.
The helper panel is translated off-screen when closed, but full-page screenshot capture still includes the off-canvas fixed element.
The fix is confined to closed/open helper state styling and ARIA state; no helper API, tool execution, send, or confirmation behavior changes.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Helper send/plan/execute behavior, email, social scheduling, payments, access grants, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, and account mutations are out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this helper closed-state cleanup, either resolve deploy/live-smoke or choose the next defect from fresh screenshot review.

operator_intent_summary: Make the Rabbi / One Time mobile Operations UI load cleanly by preventing a closed helper panel from appearing as page content in full-page screenshots and accessibility state.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No helper API, planner, tool registry, confirmation, or execution behavior change.
No new helper action, prompt, send, email, social scheduling, payment, access grant, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, account mutation, publish, unpublish, or delete.
No GHL runtime, LeadConnector reference, external CRM write, raw private evidence, or secret exposure.

known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: Closed helper panel content appears at the bottom of mobile full-page screenshots, making the initial mobile route look occluded by a helper drawer.

expanded_phrases.clean: The initial mobile page and screenshot evidence should not include closed off-canvas helper UI as visible page content.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The mobile steady state should show the route content first; helper UI appears only after the Ask action opens it.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The BNA Helper remains first-party Operations UI scoped to the current workspace and route.

requirements.statement: Make the closed Operations BNA Helper panel hidden and inert so it does not pollute mobile full-page screenshots or accessibility state.
requirements.expected_result: Mobile screenshots of Rabbi / One Time routes show route content without the closed helper bottom sheet; the Ask control still opens the helper when intentionally activated.
acceptance_criteria: Closed `.bna-helper-panel` is visually hidden/inert rather than only translated off-screen.
The helper panel exposes `aria-hidden=true` while closed and `aria-hidden=false` while open.
Mobile Program Overview after-screenshot does not show the helper sheet unless the Ask action is clicked.
No helper API calls, send/plan/execute behavior, action registry semantics, or external-write behavior changes.

criteria: Raw source and register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Current mobile screenshot evidence exists in ops/ui-audits/2026-07-02-rabbi-onetime-provider-contrast/.
The issue is visible in mobile full-page screenshots and maps to one helper shell closed/open state.
Scope is limited to public/operations.html CSS/ARIA state.
No external provider, data, payment, send, or access decision is required for local implementation.

requirements: Closed helper dialog must be aria-hidden true.

implementation_batches.scope: Closed/open visual and ARIA state for Operations BNA Helper panel.
instructions: Add hidden/inert styling to `.bna-helper-panel` while closed and restore visibility/pointer behavior for `.bna-helper-panel.open`.
Add aria-hidden state to `renderBnaHelperPanel` so closed helper is hidden from accessibility state and open helper remains accessible.
Do not change helper API methods, plan/execute/send behavior, confirmation gates, or action registry semantics.
Verify the initial mobile full-page screenshot no longer includes the closed helper panel and the Ask button can still open it.
